plain.li: The colony was underwater, and we all went on working, slower, with fish in the rafters.
My hands were full of bees in the dream, not stinging, only humming, and I couldn't put them down.
I could hear what the walls were thinking. They were worried about the roof.
The dream went on after I woke. For a while the floor kept rippling.
[child] I was a bird, and I could see the whole colony from up high.

warm.li: The ones I've lost were all out in the yard, hanging up washing, and they waved me over to help.

gloomy.li: The sun didn't come up, and we lit lamps and went on as if it had.

cold.li: The fever produced another vivid dream. I'm keeping notes on them.

plain.li: I was drowning in a warm river, and someone kept pulling me up by the collar.
In the dream the doctor was counting the medicine, and every time there was one less.
I was a long way down a corridor, and at the far end someone kept saying my name, patiently, every few breaths.

warm.li: My mother was wiping my forehead with a cool cloth. I woke up and it was the doctor.

gloomy.li: I saw my own grave, neat and well kept.

cold.li: A dream about dying. Not useful.

plain.li: The raid again. This time the gate wouldn't close, however hard I pushed.
I was on the wall and my hands were empty. I kept reaching for the rifle that wasn't there.
In the dream they came in quietly, one at a time, and sat down at our table as if they lived here.
[child] The bad men came back in my dream, but the big ones stood in front of me.

warm.li: Dreamt of the fight, and then of someone's hand on my shoulder, steering me out of it.

blunt.li: Dreamt the fight. Woke up swinging.

gloomy.li: The fight didn't end in the dream. It just went on until morning.

cold.li: The engagement again, exactly as it happened, down to the smell. Two mistakes. I've noted both.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the thing in the dark

plain.li: Something stood at the end of my bed with too many joints in its arms. It didn't move. Neither did I.
Every room in the colony had one more door than it should, and behind each one something was breathing.
Dreamt I was awake, and the dark in the corner was paying attention to me.
[child] There was a thing in my dream with no face. I hid under the blanket and it went away.

warm.li: The dark came for me in the dream, and someone lit a lamp, and it went back where it came from.

blunt.li: That thing again. In my sleep this time.

gloomy.li: The thing was still out there, in the dream. I'm not sure that part was a dream.

cold.li: The thing in the dark again. I've stopped trying to explain it.
